title: DashboardColumns
description: Columns of cards on a dashboard, one per workflow stage, pipeline step or status (To do / Doing / Done): equal-width columns with a title, a count and an accent color, stacked cards, and horizontal scrolling. With draggable, DashboardCard children move between and within columns by mouse, touch or keyboard; the board stays controlled (onCardMove).

props.description: Key of the card, reported as `cardKey` by a draggable board

props.description: Name of the card in the drag announcements and, when draggable, its accessible name

props.description: Id of the card

props.name: value
props.description: Key of the column, reported as `fromColumn` / `toColumn` by a draggable board (columns without one take no cards)

props.name: count
props.description: Number of items shown as a badge next to the title (and announced with the title); omit to hide the badge

props.name: columnWidth
props.description: Width of every column (a number is pixels). With `fill` it is the minimum width: columns stretch equally when they fit

props.name: fill
props.description: Stretches the columns equally to fill the board when they fit (they keep `columnWidth` as their minimum width and scroll otherwise)

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the columns (a number is pixels)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the board: the column bodies scroll vertically within it (a number is pixels)

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height of the board: the column bodies scroll vertically within it (a number is pixels)

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets the DashboardCard children of keyed columns (`value`) be dragged between and within columns: with the mouse, a long press on touch screens, or the keyboard (Space / Enter picks a focused card up, the arrows move it, Space / Enter drops it, Escape cancels). The board is controlled: it reports the move (`onCardMove`) and the app moves the card in its data.

props.name: canDrop
props.description: Whether a card may be dropped at a position: refused positions show no drop indicator and the keyboard skips them (its original position is always allowed)

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: DashboardColumns is a labelled, keyboard-scrollable region of DashboardColumn; each column is a group named by its title and count, and its cards (here minerva Cards) form a list. Here cards move with their own actions (a button or a menu); see Drag and drop for draggable boards.

examples.title: Colors and counts
examples.description: color puts an accent dot before the title: a theme color (primary, success, warning, danger, info, neutral) or any CSS color. count shows a badge, announced with the title. columnWidth and gap size the columns; on narrow screens they keep their width and snap while the board scrolls.

examples.title: Drag and drop
examples.description: draggable lets the DashboardCard children of keyed columns (value) be dragged: with the mouse, with a long press on touch screens, or with the keyboard (Space or Enter picks a focused card up, the arrows move it, Space or Enter drops it, Escape cancels; each step is announced). The board never reorders anything: onCardMove reports { cardKey, fromColumn, fromIndex, toColumn, toIndex } and moveDashboardCard (minerva-design/core) applies it to your lists. canDrop refuses positions: here "Doing" takes at most 2 cards.

examples.title: Empty state, actions and footer
examples.description: actions sits at the end of the header (e.g. an add button), description under it and footer below the cards. A column without cards shows empty ("No items" by default, translated). fill stretches the columns equally when they fit.

examples.title: Fixed height
examples.description: height or maxHeight bound the board: each column body scrolls vertically while the board scrolls horizontally.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: minerva-dashboard-column elements in a minerva-dashboard-columns; slotted cards get role="listitem". Here each card moves to the next column with its own button, and the script updates the count attributes; see Drag and drop for draggable boards.

colors.title: Colors and counts
colors.description: color takes a theme color (also the :state(color-success) ... custom states) or any CSS color; count shows a badge announced with the heading. column-width and gap size the columns.

empty-actions.title: Empty state and actions
empty-actions.description: The actions slot sits at the end of the header; empty-text (or the empty slot) shows while the column has no cards; fill stretches the columns when they fit.

fixed-height.title: Fixed height
fixed-height.description: height or max-height bound the board: each column body scrolls vertically while the board scrolls horizontally.

drag-drop.title: Drag and drop
drag-drop.description: With draggable, minerva-dashboard-card elements of keyed columns (value) move by mouse, touch or keyboard. The board fires minerva-card-move ({ cardKey, fromColumn, fromIndex, toColumn, toIndex }) and never moves anything itself: the script moves the card element and updates the counts. The canDrop property keeps "Doing" at 2 cards.

props.draggable: Lets the minerva-dashboard-card children of keyed columns be dragged (mouse, touch long press, keyboard); replaces the native draggable: the attribute turns it on unless it is "false"

events.minerva-card-move: A card was dropped at a new position (detail: { cardKey, fromColumn, fromIndex, toColumn, toIndex }); move the card element or re-render.

methods.focus: Focuses the scrolling region (the arrow keys then scroll it).

props.heading: Title of the column (also its accessible name; or the heading slot)
props.emptyText: Text shown when there are no cards (defaults to the translated "No items"; or the empty slot)

slots.default: The cards (each gets role="listitem" unless it has a role)
slots.heading: Rich title (alternative to the heading attribute)
slots.actions: Header controls on the end side (e.g. an add button)
slots.description: Supporting text (alternative to the description attribute)
slots.empty: Content shown when there are no cards
slots.footer: Footer below the cards (e.g. an "Add card" button)

basic.title: Native example
basic.description: A horizontal ScrollView of columns that snaps column by column; cards move with their own buttons.

drag-drop.title: Drag and drop
drag-drop.description: A long press picks a card up, the board stops scrolling, and the card drops where the finger lifts; screen readers get Move up / Move down / Move to <column> actions on each card. onCardMove reports the move.
